title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Tier Benefit: Anniversary Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members whose active physical Pocketwire Visa Debit Card is on one of the top card tiers receive the anniversary card supplement on their anniversary bonus.

## Rule

The anniversary card supplement is 1000 points when the member's active physical debit card is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card, 500 points when it is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card, and nothing when it is any other card or there is none. The supplement is added to the anniversary bonus credited for the anniversary, in whole points.

The record read is the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card whose status is active and whose form is physical, and the card tier it carries.

## Supplement by card tier

| Active physical card | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 1000 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 500 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 500 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, Gold Debit or Classic Debit | nothing |
| no active physical card | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- A Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card that is locked is not active, so it does not decide the supplement.
- A virtual card is not a physical card; the supplement is decided by the physical card alone.
